item: v3-stack-repair — (1) r13_fleet_drive writes through the mlkit writer; (2) --merged-with refuses undrivable data-bearing checks as UNMEASURABLE

base.note_on_those_two: both are M-5's OWN assertion failing on M-5's own code: core.identity._vcs_of_installed_dist interpolates the absolute package root into vcs_reason, and vcs_reason travels inside build_identity().to_dict() into every artifact an adopter stamps. This is the same defect item 1 is about and it is the reason a record cannot be regenerated through write_artifact until it is fixed; it is repaired here, not left standing.

acceptance_item_1_the_drive_writes_throu.A1: scripts/r13_fleet_drive.py writes its JSON record through resilient_mlkit.core.artifact.write_artifact and its markdown through the same machine-path discriminator; no bare Path.write_text of a record remains in the script.
acceptance_item_1_the_drive_writes_throu.A2: CONTROL FIRES: a record naming a machine path is REFUSED by the drive — nothing is written under the record's name, and the process exits non-zero. Forced by re-introducing the defect (a machine path in a row) rather than asserted.
acceptance_item_1_the_drive_writes_throu.A3: CONTROL SILENT: the repaired drive over the three mains writes a record whose artifact.machine_paths(record) == [], and whose R13 verdicts are unchanged from the committed artifact — fray FAIL with 2 findings, chokepoint FAIL with 1 finding, torrent PASS.
acceptance_item_1_the_drive_writes_throu.A4: reports/R13_FLEET_DRIVE_AT_MOVED_MAINS.json and .md are REGENERATED by the repaired script on this tree (never hand-edited, never text-merged) and carry zero machine paths.
acceptance_item_1_the_drive_writes_throu.A5: No R13 verdict moves. If any of the three mains renders a different status or a different finding count than the committed artifact, THAT IS THE RESULT and it is reported, not tuned.

acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B1: A repo may declare, per binding, the repo-relative inputs that binding reads, in a new optional [inputs] section of .mlkit/repo.toml. An empty list is a positive declaration meaning 'this binding reads nothing outside the committed tree'.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B2: On a --merged-with drive, a check whose binding declares inputs the merged worktree does not carry renders UNMEASURABLE — never FAIL and never PASS — with a reason naming the absent path.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B3: On a --merged-with drive, a check whose binding has NO [inputs] declaration renders UNMEASURABLE — never FAIL and never PASS. A merged worktree holds committed content only, so with no declaration mlkit cannot establish that the binding's inputs are present, and an unestablished input may not be rendered as a verdict.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B4: CONTROL, check-not-dead: when the declared inputs ARE present on the merged worktree, the check RUNS and renders whatever it renders. The guard must not be a blanket refusal.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B5: CONTROL, silence elsewhere: a plain (non --merged-with) drive is byte-for-byte unaffected — no check's status moves on any repo. The guard is armed only on the merged-tree drive.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B6: DRIVEN ON A REAL REPO CLONE (fray): `mlkit check --merged-with <base> --phase decision --repo fray` renders D2, D3 and D6 UNMEASURABLE, and `--phase economics` renders E1 UNMEASURABLE, when the declared inputs are absent from the merged tree. The rows are shown, not described.
acceptance_item_2_merged_tree_drive_rend.B7: UNMEASURABLE keeps the exit ladder it already has (exit 3, unmeasured, not green) and attaches no halt key: nothing is indicted.

falsifiers: The input guard fires on a plain drive -> REJECT.
Any guarded row renders FAIL or PASS instead of UNMEASURABLE -> REJECT.
The regenerated R13 record differs from the committed one in any VERDICT (status or findings) -> report the difference; do not adjust the check.
The suite is redder after the repair than the 2-failed baseline above -> REJECT.
out_of_scope: No check's semantics change beyond the two items. No threshold, range, holdout or gate file is edited.
No model repo is modified by this PR. The fray clone used for B6 is a scratch clone; its [inputs] declaration is committed only on a local branch that is never pushed.
No ledgered test read is prepared or spent.
held: No number in this file is measured; every figure above is either a git sha read from the remote or a count read from the baseline run recorded in `base`.
